sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Approved compositional quality roadmap and priority ordering.
Approved exemplar target, done contract, source boundary, and verification expectations.

verification: focused shared-reader and distribution motion tests
allowedWork: Distribution reader presentation, shared reader services needed by the exemplar, review inbox placement, TOC state, URL and scroll behavior, measured KaTeX motion, cross-surface token lineage, factoring inverse choreography, and responsive overflow behavior.
Focused reusable conformance, temporal continuity, impact selection, production-closure, bundle, build, and visual-contact-sheet verification required to prove the exemplar.
Small refactors inside touched reader and motion boundaries when independently reversible and required by an approved slice.
disallowedWork: Do not generalize visual policy to other animation families before the human exemplar checkpoint.
Do not implement nested fraction composition, structured algebra expansion, new tutorial subjects, or bounded LLM mutation.
Do not replace semantic or authoring contracts merely to repair presentation.
Do not edit unrelated user-authored roadmap, thread, decision, or design documents.
goal: Converge the distribution semantic reader into the canonical polished exemplar, prove measured cross-surface motion and reusable reader quality laws, then stop at human visual review before generalization.
commitCadence: Commit after each independently verified rollback unit; combine adjacent analysis-only slices with the first implementation slice they inform.
stopConditions: Stop when slice s21 reaches the required human visual checkpoint; do not execute post-review generalization without new approval.
Stop if the canonical accepted equation-reader behavior regresses or presentation repair would require changing semantic authoring contracts.
Stop if verification evidence is lost, an unexplained broad failure appears, or work expands into an explicitly disallowed area.
Stop if browser payload or runtime verification growth cannot be bounded by the approved topology-level architecture.

slices.title: Capture current distribution baseline
slices.summary: Captured seven forward timeline points at desktop and phone widths; baseline proves current endpoint tests pass but do not catch temporal discontinuity, percentage positioning, missing review chrome, or inverse choreography quality.

slices.title: Freeze exemplar acceptance and preservation boundaries
slices.summary: Canonical reference is the accepted x-plus-3 equation reader motion and shared exemplar reader chrome. Acceptance requires continuous measured token motion, coordinated algebra and geometry, true reversible factoring, working TOC/review/URL behavior, and no overflow. Preserve semantic traces, Markdown/searchability, endpoint KaTeX, and authoring contracts. Roll back reader chrome, motion adapter, and verification harness independently; do not promote before human contact-sheet approval.

slices.title: Map bespoke and shared reader behavior
slices.summary: Shared and reusable: compiled TOC markup, reader CSS, dev-review bootstrap and placement, font readiness, URL codec concepts, responsive projection, semantic focus, and frame scheduling. Incorrectly embedded in exemplar-entry: TOC/ARIA activation and review-frame lifecycle. Distribution-specific: semantic trace sampling, area SVG projection, cross-surface correspondence, direction controls, and choreography. First rollback unit will extract only reader chrome services and mount them on distribution.

slices.title: Restore non-occluding review inbox
slices.summary: Distribution now mounts the shared dev-review inbox, emits temporal semantic/render capture data on render and request, and keeps the wide panel wholly in the left prose rail. Five focused browser tests pass.

slices.title: Restore TOC and accessibility current synchronization
slices.summary: A shared active-location runtime now owns TOC highlighting, aria-current location, beat activation, and aria-current step for both equation and distribution readers. Eight cross-route browser checks pass.

slices.title: Verify URL scroll rewind and deep-link behavior
slices.summary: Exact inverse moments now have regression coverage: copied URLs preserve lesson/version/checkpoint/progress/direction and restore the same material owner. Existing URL, scroll, rewind, TOC, focus, and static-searchability behavior remains green across six browser tests.

slices.title: Establish font readiness before motion measurement
slices.summary: Distribution now waits for final equation fonts before rendering, scheduling scroll, mounting capture, or reporting geometry; later loadingdone invalidations rerender the same semantic moment. Seven browser and two compiler checks pass.

slices.title: Give algebraic and geometric tokens stable identities
slices.summary: Factored, distributed, and expanded KaTeX states now expose sixteen stable selector anchors; all material fragments and geometric labels expose shared lineage IDs. Seven semantic/compiler checks pass, providing a DOM-shape-independent basis for measurement and scheduling.

slices.title: Measure source and destination KaTeX geometry
slices.summary: A validated distribution layout snapshot now measures all sixteen source/intermediate/target anchors relative to the algebra stage, exposes stable centers and dimensions, and refuses missing or duplicate topology. Five focused tests and full typecheck pass.
